svg.title: Checkout and fulfilment, named services and queues
svg.desc: storefront-web calls checkout-api, which enqueues orders_pending. order-worker consumes it, authorises payment, writes to orders-db and enqueues fulfilment_pending for fulfilment-worker, which books the carrier.
